capabilities: Convert test paper and artwork photos into Markdown via OCR, ordered by capture time
Analyze key exam questions with an LLM and generate new related practice questions
Convert selected English text into embedded audio with British or American pronunciation
Manage a vocabulary list of new English words linked to the passages they appear in
Generate names and descriptions for children's drawings and handicrafts
disambiguation: Not a git repository manager; 'repo' here means a child's study archive of school materials.
extras: README is written in Chinese (with an English link at top); drawing analysis requires a multimodal LLM while other features need only a text model; photos must be taken in page order for correct Markdown ordering; planned features include knowledge base search and improved OCR display.
motivation: The author built it as a gift for his daughter Xiaoyu, to record her growth and make learning enjoyable.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn photos of test papers, drawings, and handwritten work into organized Markdown records or to analyze them for learning.
